mission: Turn autonomous AI engineering research into reproducible code-level capability improvements without weakening security, correctness, permission boundaries, or evidence standards.
promotion_rule: A strategy proxy or internal score is never sufficient. Promotion requires a bounded implementation, relevant tests, counterevidence, reproducible rerun evidence, and explicit limitations.

tracks.title: Behavioral Evaluation Harness
tracks.hypothesis: AI development improves faster when each candidate is judged by stable behavioral fixtures and holdout cases instead of strategy proxy alone.
tracks.deliverable: machine-readable eval manifest plus deterministic regression and holdout evidence

tracks.title: Persistent Failure and Learning Memory
tracks.hypothesis: Preserving failed hypotheses and regression fingerprints across runs reduces repeated dead-end research and improves autonomous next-step selection.
tracks.deliverable: bounded failure-memory contract with recurrence detection and expiry rules

tracks.title: Multi-Agent Specialist League
tracks.hypothesis: Independent specialist proposals plus tournament adjudication produce more robust AI engineering changes than a single self-scored proposal stream.
tracks.deliverable: specialist proposal league with diversity, counterevidence, independent scoring and one bounded champion

tracks.title: Tool-Use Reliability and Permission Boundaries
tracks.hypothesis: AI agents become more useful when tool invocation, retries, approvals and failure states are measurable while permissions remain least-privilege.
tracks.deliverable: tool-use fixture pack with expected/observed results, retry/recovery evidence and permission-boundary checks

tracks.title: Autonomous Recovery and Observability
tracks.hypothesis: Self-monitoring, bounded retries and evidence-preserving recovery increase autonomous AI uptime without hiding failure.
tracks.deliverable: failure injection and recovery evidence with stable fingerprints and escalation criteria

tracks.title: AI Portfolio Proof Pack
tracks.hypothesis: AI engineering becomes commercially legible when each improvement has a before/after artifact, reproducibility evidence, limitations and a customer-readable use case.
tracks.deliverable: human-inspectable AI capability evidence card backed by code/test evidence

tracks.title: Security-Guarded Autonomous Development
tracks.hypothesis: AI development can move faster when Security supplies priority-only adversarial feedback while regression, permission and external-scope gates remain independent and fail-closed.
tracks.deliverable: AI-to-Security and Security-to-AI evidence contract with independent promotion gates
